# Consumer Credit Matters — data site

> Performance and issuance data on SEC-registered U.S. auto and credit card ABS, built daily from
> SEC Form 10-D servicer reports, Form ABS-EE loan-level data and prospectuses (424B, FWP).

## Auto ABS performance (one page per issuer shelf)

## Other pages

- [Methodology](https://consumercreditmatters.com/abs/methodology.html): how each figure is defined
- [Issuance and presale reports](https://consumercreditmatters.com/abs/issuance/): one report per deal from 2024
- [Newsletter](https://consumercreditmatters.com/newsletter/): weekly briefings

## Data files

- `https://consumercreditmatters.com/abs/performance/data/<TICKER>.json` — a shelf's deals, latest reports, pooled monthly series and definitions
- `https://consumercreditmatters.com/abs/performance/data/peers.json` — every auto deal's terms and structure at pricing
- `https://consumercreditmatters.com/abs/performance/data/<TICKER>.deals.html` — the shelf's Deals table as HTML
